title: 40 texts in a row. Gemini calls it hi.
caption: 2016: forty texts in a row, one thought each, until the other phone hit 1%. 2026: one message. It is a nine-minute voice note. Growth, kind of. Send this to the Gemini whose voice notes need chapters.
